title: Entropy bound from a pointwise upper bound
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $q:\iota\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $0\le q(x)\le M$ for every $x\in\iota$, with uniform mean $1$. Then the uniform expectation of $q(x)\log q(x)$ is at most $\log M$.
